Nashville based SiteVue AI manufactures mounted and wearable cameras with AI analysis to give manufacturers, processors, and builders real time visibility into their operations. The subscription-based platform identifies process bottlenecks, product defects, equipment drift and breakdowns, mispacks, misships, cycle-times, labor times, near-misses, and ensures PPE compliance - all with visual traceability. It can also alert teams to production issues real time, and even stop the line.

Facilities using SiteVue AI typically see +3% profit margin growth in under 3 months; including a 10–20% improvement in floor efficiency, 5–10% increase in product quality, 5-10% recovery of labor hours, and a 90% decrease in safety incidents.
